family: Trend-following and momentum strategies applied intraday and daily on index/commodity futures

specs.name: Zarattini-Barbon-Aziz Noise Area intraday momentum (semi-hourly bands, band-only or TWAP-proxy stop, VIX/NR4 regime gate)
specs.pseudocode: PRE per session d (RTH 1-min bars): D=daily_bars(rth_only); O930[d]=D.open; prev_close[d]=D.close.shift(1); atr=ATR14d (daily_atr shifted). move[d,t]=|close(bar tod t)/O930[d]-1| for every RTH tod t. M=pivot(move) rows=day_id cols=tod; sigma[d,t]=M.rolling(lookback,min_periods=lookback).mean().shift(1) (days d-1..d-lookback only). upper[d,t]=max(O930,prev_close)*(1+vm*sigma); lower[d,t]=min(O930,prev_close)*(1-vm*sigma). twap[d,t]=session_vwap (typical-price TWAP, flagged VWAP approximation; only for stop_mode own_band_twap). allowed[d]= sigma&atr not NaN AND (regime none | vix: VIX_lag>=vix_min | nr4: prior day NR4). STATE MACHINE at T in {10:00,10:30,...,15:30}: c=close of bar tod T-1; i=index of bar tod T (market at open); U=upper[d,T-1]; L=lower[d,T-1]. pos==0: c>U -> place(i,+1,stop_px=c-hard_stop_atr*atr); c<L and not long_only -> place(i,-1,stop_px=c+hard_stop_atr*atr). pos==+1: stop_level = L (opp_band) or max(U,twap) (own_band_twap); if c<stop_level: exit_at(i), pos=0; if opp_band and c<L and not long_only: place(i+1,-1,...) (reverse one bar later, engine one-position). pos==-1 mirror. Hard 1-min stop may fire between decisions; next decision sees pos 0 (re-entry allowed). set_session('10:00','15:31','15:55'); max_trades_day=6.
specs.params_grid: lookback {14,90}; vm {1.0,1.5}; stop_mode {opp_band, own_band_twap}; regime {none, vix(>=18), nr4}; hard_stop_atr {0.35,0.6}. Fixed step 30 min; extra long_only=True run on MNQ.
specs.session_rules: Entries 10:00-15:30 ET at HH:00/HH:30 only; flat 15:55; RTH-only features from 09:30; VIX lagged one day
specs.risk_rules: Hard stop 0.35-0.6 x ATR14d per trade (ES ~25-50 pts = $125-250/MES -> expect 5-8 micros). Per micro: daily_loss_stop MES $60 / MNQ $80 (x1.0); daily_profit_stop MES $120 / MNQ $160 x1.5 (consistency cap). Max 6 trades/day (reversals). One position at a time.
specs.evidence: SPY 2007-24: Sharpe 0.61 (opp-band stop), 1.24 (band+VWAP), 1.33 with vol sizing (SSRN 4824172). NQ 2010-24 (Quantitativo, 90-day/scaled): 24%/yr, Sharpe 1.67, WR 38%, payoff 2.25. codecat-ops ES/SPY: Sharpe 1.1 full sample, ~0 in 2025-26. Sharpe 1.5 when VIX>20; after NR4 day 22 bps/day t=5.1.
specs.data_gap: True VWAP stop needs volume; TWAP (equal-weighted typical price) used as flagged proxy, base opp-band variant needs no volume. Paper's vol-target sizing replaced by Lucid micro scan.

specs.name: Filtered ORB: daily SMA-200 bias, opposite-side stop capped, R-multiple target, one-loss-per-day cap (OOS-validated MNQ variant)
specs.pseudocode: PRE: OR=opening_range('09:30',or_minutes)->or_high,or_low,i_end; atr=ATR14d; bias=SMA_D(bias_len) of RTH daily closes shifted. long_ok=O930>bias; short_ok=O930<bias. rng=or_high-or_low; trade only if min_range_atr*atr<=rng<=max_range_atr*atr. ENTRY (as strategies/orb.py): from i0=i_end+1 scan 1-min bars until last_entry/valid_minutes: buy stop at or_high+buffer (if long_ok), sell stop at or_low-buffer (if short_ok); first touched side is the position (both in one bar -> side nearer that bar's open). place(i0,side,entry_px=level,kind='stop',valid_bars=valid_minutes,stop_px,tgt_px). STOP: opposite OR side capped: long stop_px=max(or_low-buffer, entry-stop_cap_usd/point_value) (mirror short). TARGET: tgt_px=entry+rr*(entry-stop_px). 4c's next-open exit replaced by flat 15:55. daily_loss_stop=0.9*stop_cap_usd (one full stop-out halts the day). set_session('09:30','11:30','15:55'); max_trades_day=1.
specs.params_grid: or_minutes {15,30}; bias_len {100,200}; rr {1.5,2.5,4.0}; stop_cap_usd {75,150}; direction {both,long_only}. Fixed buffer 1 tick, last_entry 11:30, valid 120 min.
specs.session_rules: Entries 09:45/10:00-11:30 ET; stop orders valid 120 min; flat 15:55
specs.risk_rules: $R <= $75-150 per micro; daily loss stop = 0.9 x stop cap (one losing trade ends the day); daily_profit_stop Lucid block x1.0 (MES $120 / MNQ $160 per micro); max 1 trade/day. 25% WR profile clusters profits -> verify consistency in Lucid MC.
specs.evidence: Backtests-Not-Signals MNQ: IS Feb-2020..Dec-2022 CAGR 19.3% Sharpe 1.37 MDD 10.9%; OOS Jan-2023..Feb-2026 CAGR 15.7%, Sharpe 1.10, PF 1.32, MDD 12.8%, WR 24.9%, 474 trades. Base rates: long breakouts +9 pts continuation vs shorts (ES/NQ 2014-26).

specs.name: 15/30-min ORB with 5-min close confirmation, 0.5x-range target, opposite-side capped stop, OR-size filter (high win-rate variant)
specs.pseudocode: PRE: OR=opening_range('09:30',or_minutes); rng=or_high-or_low; atr=ATR14d; price=or_close; trade day only if rng/price<=max_or_pct AND rng>=min_range_atr*atr. B5=resample(df1,5,rth_only=True) bars with tod>=09:30+or_minutes. ENTRY: scan B5 bars of day d while bar.tod<last_entry: if close>or_high: side=+1, i=bar.i_next, break; if close<or_low: side=-1 if direction=='both' else no trade today (first close below OR low = skip), break. If bias_len>0 require O930>SMA_D(bias_len) for longs (mirror). place(i,side) market at next 1-min open. STOP: opposite OR side capped: long stop_px=max(or_low, entry_ref-stop_cap_usd/point_value), entry_ref=confirming close. TARGET: tgt_px=entry_ref+tgt_frac*rng (mirror short). No trail. set_session('09:30','11:30','15:55'); max_trades_day=1; daily_loss_stop=1 x stop_cap_usd.
specs.params_grid: or_minutes {15,30}; tgt_frac {0.5,0.75,1.0}; stop_cap_usd {100,150}; max_or_pct {0.0055,0.008}; direction {long_only,both}. Fixed confirm 5 min, min_range_atr 0.10, last_entry 11:30. No weekday grid (published weekday exclusions are overfit).
specs.session_rules: Confirmation bars from OR end to 11:30 ET; flat 15:55
specs.risk_rules: $R <= $100-150 per micro; one trade/day; daily_loss_stop = stop cap; daily_profit_stop Lucid block x1.0. ~1:1 payoff at 65-75% WR; target ~4 ES pts = $21/MES -> 10-20 micros gives $200-400 wins (>= $150 payout days).
specs.evidence: edgeful ES 5-min ORB 6 months to Apr-2026: 115 trades, 72% WR, PF 1.62. TradeThatSwing NQ 15-min ORB Oct-24..Oct-25: 114 trades, 75% WR, PF 2.51, MDD $2,725/NQ; flat in 90 days to Jul-2026. TradingStats 2014-26: 30-min OR 5-min-close continuation 71% ES / 72% NQ, 77% when OR > 0.6x ATR; 0.5x extension hit 68-72%.

specs.name: Initial Balance (09:30-10:30) breakout with C-period (10:30-11:00) close confirmation, narrow-IB filter, IB-mid stop, 1x IB target
specs.pseudocode: PRE: IB=opening_range('09:30',60)->ib_high,ib_low,ib_mid,width; atr=ATR14d; trade only if min_ib_atr*atr<=width<=max_ib_atr*atr. C=resample(df1,confirm_minutes,rth_only=True) bars with tod>=10:30, first confirm_windows bars. ENTRY: first C bar with close>ib_high -> long at bar.i_next (market); close<ib_low -> short if direction allows. Optional shallow-retrace guard: (bar.high-close)<=0.25*width. STOP: stop_mode mid -> ib_mid; opp -> ib_low (long); cap: no farther than 0.5*atr from confirming close. TARGET: tgt_px=ib_high+tgt_ib*width (long). If trail: trail_pts=0.5*width, trail_act_pts=0.5*width, tgt_ib=1.5. RE-ENTRY: with max_trades=2 opposite side may trigger after stop-out. set_session('10:30','12:00','15:55').
specs.params_grid: confirm_minutes {5,30}; max_ib_atr {0.5,0.8}; stop_mode {mid,opp}; tgt_ib {0.5,1.0}; direction {both,long_only}. Fixed IB 60 min, min_ib_atr 0.15, last_entry 12:00, max_trades 1 (one extra run with 2).
specs.risk_rules: Stop ~0.25 ATR (ES 8-10 pts = $40-50/MES) for 'mid'; capped 0.5 ATR; max 1-2 trades/day; Lucid block daily stops (MES $60/$120, MNQ $80/$160 per micro).
specs.evidence: TradingStats ES/NQ 2015-2025 (2,686/2,833 days): 100% IB extension 18.8% unconditional vs 45.5% ES / 33.2% NQ after C-period close above IB high (50%/41.7% below IB low); narrow IB (<0.5 ATR) median extension 74.8% vs 22.3% extreme; shallow (<25%) retrace -> 93.8% close in break direction. No published P&L.

specs.name: Crabel ORB after NR4/NR7/inside-day: open +/- Stretch stop entries, opposite level as stop, exit at close or R target
specs.pseudocode: PRE (daily RTH bars, shifted so day d uses days<d): range=H-L; noise=min(H-O,O-L); stretch[d]=SMA(noise over d-stretch_len..d-1)*stretch_mult. NR4[d]=range[d-1]==min(range[d-4..d-1]); NR7 analog; ID[d]=H[d-1]<H[d-2] and L[d-1]>L[d-2]. setup_ok per `setup`; atr=ATR14d; require stretch & atr not NaN. ENTRY at first RTH bar i0 (tod 09:30): O=open of i0; buy stop at O+stretch, sell stop at O-stretch; first touched side wins (resolve on 1-min as orb.py; both in one bar -> side nearer that bar's open); valid until min(last_entry, i0+valid_minutes). place(i0,side,entry_px=level,kind='stop',valid_bars=valid_minutes,stop_px,tgt_px). STOP: opposite level (O-stretch for long) => R=2*stretch, capped at max_stop_atr*atr from entry. TARGET: tgt_mode close -> none (flat 15:55); rr -> entry+rr*R. set_session('09:30','11:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=1. Gold: pit hours 08:20-13:30, flat 13:25.
specs.params_grid: setup {nr4,nr7,nr4_or_id}; stretch_mult {1.0,1.5,2.0}; tgt_mode {close, rr} with rr {1.5,3.0}; max_stop_atr {0.3,0.5}. Fixed stretch_len 10, last_entry 11:00, valid 90 min.
specs.risk_rules: R ~ 2 x stretch (ES 10-20 pts = $50-100/MES) before the ATR cap; one trade/day on ~15-25% of days; Lucid block daily stops.
specs.evidence: Crabel 1990 S&P tables: 203 trades 71% profitable avg win $343/loss $289; OxfordStrat 42 futures 1980-2013 positive sensitivity; Zarattini Table 5: intraday momentum after NR4 22 bps/day t=5.14 (Sharpe 3.2), NR7 16 bps t=3.07.

specs.name: Gap-and-go: large opening gap outside prior day's range, break of first 5/15-min high, range-low or gap-mid stop, 1x range target or ATR trail
specs.pseudocode: PRE: gap[d]=O930-prev_close; atr=ATR14d; pd_high/pd_low prior RTH extremes. up_day = gap>=gap_atr*atr and (not outside_prior_range or O930>pd_high); dn_day = gap<=-gap_atr*atr and (… O930<pd_low) and direction=='both'. FR=opening_range('09:30',range_minutes)->fr_high,fr_low,i_end. ENTRY: i0=i_end+1; up_day: buy stop at fr_high+1 tick; dn_day: sell stop at fr_low-1 tick; valid until last_entry/valid_minutes. place(i0,side,entry_px,kind='stop',valid_bars,stop_px,tgt_px,trail_pts,trail_act_pts). STOP: range_low -> fr_low-1 tick (long); gap_mid -> (O930+prev_close)/2; capped at max_stop_atr*atr from entry. TARGET: entry+tgt_mult*(fr_high-fr_low). If trail_atr>0: no target, trail_pts=trail_act_pts=trail_atr*atr. set_session('09:30','10:30','15:55'); max_trades_day=1.
specs.params_grid: gap_atr {0.5,0.7,1.0}; range_minutes {5,15}; stop_mode {range_low,gap_mid}; tgt_mult {1.0,1.5} plus one trail_atr=0.3 run; direction {both,long_only}. Fixed outside_prior_range True, last_entry 10:30, valid 60 min.
specs.session_rules: Stop order live from OR end until 10:30 ET; flat 15:55
specs.risk_rules: Large-gap days are high-ATR (NQ MAE P90 ~200 pts = $400/MNQ): ATR cap on stop mandatory; expect 3-6 micros on MNQ; one trade/day; Lucid block daily stops. ~10-15% of days trade -> pair with specs 3/9.
specs.evidence: TradingStats NQ 2015-2025 (2,791 days): same-day fill 77.8% tiny gaps, 25.6% 0.7-1.2x ATR, 8.2% > 1.2x ATR; open above prior range fills 47%; gap-and-go WR quoted 50-55% (edgeful/crosstrade), no P&L curve.

specs.name: Larry Williams volatility breakout: open +/- k x prior-day range stop entries, optional SMA-20 bias, exit at close or R target
specs.pseudocode: PRE: prange[d]=High(d-1)-Low(d-1) of RTH ('rth') or full 18:00-17:00 session ('session'); atr=ATR14d; bias sma20: longs only when prev_close>SMA_D(20), shorts only below. ENTRY at i0 (tod 09:30): O=open of i0; buy stop O+k_buy*prange; sell stop O-k_sell*prange; first touched wins (1-min resolution as orb.py). place(i0,side,entry_px,kind='stop',valid_bars=150,stop_px,tgt_px). STOP: entry-stop_k*prange (long) capped at max_stop_atr*atr. TARGET: close -> none (flat 15:55); rr -> entry+rr*R. set_session('09:30','12:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=1. Gold pit 08:20-13:30, flat 13:25.
specs.params_grid: k_buy=k_sell {0.3,0.5}; range_src {rth,session}; bias {none,sma20}; tgt_mode {close, rr(2.0)}; stop_k {0.3,0.5}.
specs.risk_rules: Wide gate (ES 0.5 x 60-pt range = 30 pts): stop 15-30 pts = $75-150/MES after cap -> 1-4 micros headroom; one trade/day; Lucid block daily stops.
specs.evidence: Williams (1999); MQL5 XAUUSD daily Jan-Nov 2025 +60% on $10k (no WR/PF); no credible 2020s ES/NQ test. Structurally an ATR-scaled ORB.

specs.name: Composite trend-day flag at 10:30 (outside gap, narrow IB, open-drive, NR prior day), trade in direction of the open, ATR trailing runner to 15:55
specs.pseudocode: PRE: atr=ATR14d; pd_high/pd_low/prev_close; IB=opening_range('09:30',60); OR30=opening_range('09:30',30). Flags at 10:30 (bars<=10:29): a) gap_out=|O930-prev_close|>=0.7*atr and O930 outside [pd_low,pd_high]; b) narrow_ib=(ib_high-ib_low)<0.5*atr; c) open_drive=OR30 closes in top 25% of its range and or30_close>pd_high (or bottom 25% and <pd_low); d) nr_prior=NR4 or NR7 or ID. score=a+b+c+d; direction=sign(close_1029-O930). Negative filters: IB width>1.5*atr -> skip; skip_after_trend_day: |C(d-1)-O(d-1)|>=0.7*range(d-1) -> skip. trade_day = score>=min_score and direction!=0. ENTRY: market_1030 -> place(i of bar tod 10:30, direction); ib_break_stop -> buy stop ib_high+1 tick (dir>0) / sell stop ib_low-1 tick, valid until 12:00. STOP: ib_mid or opposite IB extreme, capped at max_stop_atr*atr. EXIT: trail_pts=trail_atr*atr, trail_act_pts=trail_act_atr*atr (engine ratchet); optional tgt_px=entry+tgt_atr*atr; flat 15:55. set_session('10:30','12:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=1.
specs.params_grid: min_score {1,2}; entry_mode {market_1030, ib_break_stop}; stop_mode {ib_mid, ib_opp}; trail_atr {0.25,0.4}; tgt_atr {0 (runner),1.0}; direction both (second run long_only).
specs.risk_rules: Stop 0.25-0.5 ATR; 1-3 trades/week; daily_profit_stop Lucid block x1.5 (trend days earn the target but must stay < 50% of $3k); daily_loss_stop x1.0; max 1 trade/day.
specs.evidence: Synthesis of 2014-2026 base rates: only ~10% of ES sessions are trend days; narrow IB extends 3.4x further than extreme IB; large outside gaps fill 8%; NR4 prior day doubles intraday momentum P&L; wide 30-min OR continues 77.5% ES. No published composite P&L.

specs.name: Gao-Han-Li-Zhou market intraday momentum: first half-hour sign predicts last half-hour, with r12 agreement variant and VIX gate
specs.pseudocode: PRE: c1000=close of bar tod 09:59; c1500=close of bar tod 14:59; c1530=close of bar tod 15:29; atr=ATR14d. r1=c1000/ref_px-1 with ref_px=prev_close (paper) or O930; r12=c1530/c1500-1. signal=sign(r1) if |c1000-ref_px|>=thresh_atr*atr else 0; variant r1_r12: signal=0 unless sign(r12)==sign(r1); vix_min>0 and VIX_lag<vix_min -> 0. ENTRY: place(i of bar tod 15:30, signal, stop_pts=stop_atr*atr) market at 15:30 open. EXIT: flat 15:58 via set_session('15:30','15:31','15:58'); protective stop only, no target. max_trades_day=1. Extends existing strategies/intraday_momentum.py.
specs.params_grid: ref {prev_close, open}; variant {r1, r1_r12}; thresh_atr {0.0,0.2}; stop_atr {0.3,0.6}; vix_min {0,18}.
specs.session_rules: Entry exactly 15:30 ET; flat 15:58 (last allowed); gold analog 13:00 -> 13:28
specs.risk_rules: One trade/day; hard stop 0.3-0.6 ATR; tiny edge (~1.5 ES pts): at 10-20 MES avg day ~$75-150 -> consistency filler / afternoon leg for the funded '5 days >= $150' rule, not an eval passer alone.
specs.evidence: JFE 2018 SPY 1993-2013: eta(r1) 6.67%/yr Sharpe 1.08 success 54.4%; eta(r1,r12) Sharpe 0.98 success 77%; similar on S&P futures; QuantConnect 2015-20 Sharpe -0.63 overall, 1.45 in Feb-Mar 2020; later OOS strength down ~75%.
specs.data_gap: Macro-release-day gate (FOMC/CPI) needs an event calendar not in the data; VIX gate used instead.

specs.name: Raschke-Connors Holy Grail: ADX(14) > 30 and rising, first pullback to 20-EMA on 5-min, buy stop at touch-bar high; swing or Keltner stop
specs.pseudocode: PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True) continuous RTH series (min_periods full): EMA=ema(close,20); ADX=adx(B,14); ATR5=atr(B,14). up_trend[k]=ADX[k]>adx_min and ADX[k]>ADX[k-1] and EMA[k]>EMA[k-3] and close[k-1]>EMA[k-1]. touch_long[k]=up_trend and low[k]<=EMA[k] and close[k]>EMA[k]-0.5*ATR5[k] (first touch). Shorts mirror. ENTRY: buy stop at high[k]+1 tick placed at B.i_next[k], valid_bars=valid_minutes (1-min). place(i_next,+1,entry_px,kind='stop',valid_bars,stop_px,tgt_px,trail_pts,trail_act_pts). STOP: swing -> min(low[k-2..k])-1 tick; keltner -> EMA[k]-kc_mult*ATR5[k]; cap 0.5*ATR14d. TARGET: swing -> max(high[k-20..k]) (skip if < entry+1R); rr -> entry+rr*R. TRAIL: trail_pts=R, trail_act_pts=R (approximates trail-to-EMA). Re-entry on next EMA touch while up_trend (max_trades 3). set_session('10:00','15:00','15:55'). Optional trend_day_only gate from spec 8.
specs.params_grid: adx_min {25,30}; stop_mode {swing,keltner}; tgt_mode {swing, rr(1.5)}; bar {5,15}; max_trades {1,3}. Fixed ema 20, kc_mult 2.0, valid 30 min.
specs.risk_rules: Tight stops (ES 4-8 pts = $20-40/MES); max 3 trades/day; Lucid block daily stops; drop if PF < 1.2 on 2023-2026.
specs.evidence: Street Smarts (1995); no quantified ES/NQ backtest; one-month XAUUSD H1 anecdote 57% WR 1.5 R:R. Keltner pullback (Raschke) folded in as stop_mode keltner (vendor-only evidence).
specs.data_gap: None (ADX/EMA from OHLC); common.adx returns ADX only, direction taken from EMA slope

specs.name: 9/21 EMA cross then first pullback to EMA21 on 5-min, SMA-200 daily bias and optional trend-day gate
specs.pseudocode: PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): EF=ema(close,9); ES_=ema(close,21); ATR5=atr(B,14). cross_up[k]=EF[k]>ES_[k] and EF[k-1]<=ES_[k-1]; state armed_long from cross_up until cross_down. bias_len>0: longs only if O930>SMA_D(bias_len) (mirror); trend_day_only: require spec-8 score>=2 at 10:30. pullback_long[k]=armed_long and low[k]<=ES_[k] and close[k]>ES_[k] (first per cross). ENTRY: require_pullback -> buy stop high[k]+1 tick at B.i_next[k], valid 20 1-min bars; else market at i_next of cross bar. STOP: min(low[k], ES_[k]-0.5*ATR5[k])-1 tick, cap 0.5*ATR14d. TARGET: entry+rr*R. Also exit_at(i_next of cross_down bar). set_session('09:45','15:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=3.
specs.risk_rules: Many signals -> commissions; max 3 trades/day; Lucid block daily stops; keep only if gated version clears PF 1.3 with >= 150 trades.
specs.evidence: Raw 9/21 cross on ES 5-min: 30-50 trades/quarter, 60-65% losers, PF ~1.2 (one blog test); filtered 65-80% WR claims unsourced; no OOS evidence.
specs.data_gap: VWAP confirmation in practitioner versions needs volume; omitted

specs.name: Supertrend (10,3) or Parabolic SAR stop-and-flip on 15/60-min bars, long-biased, daily SMA-200 gate, flat before close (gold first)
specs.pseudocode: PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=False for gold / True for equities): supertrend: hl2=(H+L)/2; up=hl2+st_mult*ATR(st_len); dn=hl2-st_mult*ATR(st_len); ratchet dn[k]=max(dn[k],dn[k-1]) while close[k-1]>dn[k-1] (up mirrors); trend[k]=+1 if close[k]>up[k-1], -1 if close[k]<dn[k-1], else trend[k-1]; line=dn when +1, up when -1. psar: Wilder SAR (0.02,0.02,0.20), trend=+1 while close>SAR. flip_up[k]=trend[k]==+1 and trend[k-1]==-1 (mirror). bias: longs only if prev_close>SMA_D(bias_len). ENTRY: flip_up within [entry_start,last_entry): place(B.i_next[k],+1,stop_px=line[k] or SAR[k], capped at hard_stop_atr*ATR14d). EXIT: flip_dn -> exit_at(B.i_next[k]) (reverse to short at i_next+1 if direction both); hard stop; flat at `flat`. Ratcheting line not re-sent each bar: bar-close flip exit + fixed hard stop approximate it. Gold: set_session('03:00','15:00','16:30'); equities ('09:35','15:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=2.
specs.params_grid: bar {15,60}; trail_type {supertrend,psar}; st_mult {2.0,3.0} (supertrend only); direction {long_only,both}; bias_len {0,200}.
specs.session_rules: Gold: entries 03:00-15:00 ET, flat 16:30 (never past 16:45); equities 09:35-15:00, flat 15:55
specs.risk_rules: Hard stop <= 0.6 ATR14d; max 2 trades/day; MGC daily stops $80/$160 per micro. 33-37% WR profile conflicts with consistency rule; intraday-flat truncates the H4 winners -> expect PF ~1.0-1.2; treat as exit tool unless it clears PF 1.3.

specs.name: Long-only Donchian 20/55-bar breakout on 15-min gold with daily SMA-200 or 12-month TSMOM gate, 10/20-bar exit, flat by 16:30
specs.pseudocode: PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=False gold / True equities): hh[k]=max(high[k-n_entry..k-1]); ll[k]=min(low[k-n_exit..k-1]); ATRb=atr(B,20) (windows exclude bar k). bias_ok[d]: sma200 -> prev_close>SMA_D(200); tsmom12 -> prev_close>close 252 sessions earlier; none -> True. breakout[k]=close[k]>hh[k] and bias_ok and bar start tod in [entry_start,last_entry). ENTRY: place(B.i_next[k],+1,stop_px=max(close[k]-stop_atr_bars*ATRb[k], close[k]-max_stop_atr*ATR14d)). EXIT: close[k]<ll[k] -> exit_at(B.i_next[k]); hard stop; flat at `flat`; optional tgt rr 2.0. Gold set_session('02:00','13:00','16:30'); equities ('09:35','15:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=2. Daily Turtle (overnight) NOT specced.
specs.params_grid: n_entry {20,55}; n_exit {10,20}; bias {sma200,tsmom12,none}; tgt {none, rr2.0}; bar {15,60}.

specs.name: Bollinger-inside-Keltner squeeze release on 5-min, momentum-direction entry, opposite-KC stop, R target or trail
specs.pseudocode: PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): mid=sma(close,20); sd=rolling std(close,20); bb_up/dn=mid+-2*sd; kc_up/dn=ema(close,20)+-kc_mult*atr(B,20). squeeze[k]=bb_up<kc_up and bb_dn>kc_dn; run[k]=consecutive squeeze bars ending at k. fire[k]=not squeeze[k] and squeeze[k-1] and run[k-1]>=min_squeeze_bars. mom[k]=close[k]-((max(high[k-19..k])+min(low[k-19..k]))/2+mid[k])/2; side=sign(mom). ENTRY: place(B.i_next[k],side) market when fire and side!=0 and tod in window. STOP: opposite KC band at k (kc_dn long), cap 0.5*ATR14d. TARGET: entry+rr*R; trail -> trail_pts=R, act=R, no target. set_session('10:00','15:00','15:55'); max_trades_day=2.
specs.risk_rules: Stop = KC width (~1.5-2 x 5-min ATR) capped 0.5 ATR14d; max 2 trades/day; Lucid block daily stops; drop if PF < 1.2 on 2023-2026.
